name: Distribution of Dolphins
description: This course explores the various species of dolphins, their habitats, behaviors, and conservation efforts.
author: 654f9ec2ea7ead465908d1e3

modules.name: Dolphin Anatomy
modules.description: An overview of dolphin anatomy, from external features to internal systems.

lessons.name: External Features
lessons.description: Identify and describe external anatomy: fins, fluke, rostrum, blowhole.

lessons.name: Internal Systems
lessons.description: Introduction to respiratory, circulatory, and nervous systems in dolphins.

modules.name: Dolphin Species and Classification
modules.description: Survey of major dolphin species and their classification within Cetacea.

lessons.name: Oceanic vs Coastal Species
lessons.description: Compare habitat, behavior, and morphology between oceanic and coastal dolphins.

lessons.name: Species Profiles
lessons.description: Detailed profiles of bottlenose, spinner, and common dolphin species.

modules.name: Dolphin Habitats and Distribution
modules.description: Where dolphins live: ranges, preferred environments, and biogeography.

lessons.name: Coastal Habitats
lessons.description: Estuaries, bays, and nearshore systems used by coastal dolphins.

lessons.name: Open Ocean Ranges
lessons.description: Migration patterns and range maps for oceanic species.

lessons.name: Human Impacts on Habitat
lessons.description: How shipping, fishing, and coastal development alter dolphin habitats.

modules.name: Dolphin Behavior and Social Structure
modules.description: Social organization, communication, and foraging behaviors of dolphins.

lessons.name: Social Groups and Pods
lessons.description: Pod structure, alliances, and group foraging strategies.

lessons.name: Vocalizations and Echolocation
lessons.description: How dolphins use sound to communicate and navigate.

modules.name: Dolphin Diets and Foraging
modules.description: Feeding strategies, prey types, and the role of dolphins in food webs.

lessons.name: Prey Types
lessons.description: Common prey (fish, squid) and how diet varies by species and region.

lessons.name: Foraging Techniques
lessons.description: Herding, strand feeding, and cooperative hunting behaviors.

modules.name: Conservation and Management
modules.description: Threats to dolphin populations and conservation strategies.

lessons.name: Threats and Mortality
lessons.description: Bycatch, pollution, noise, and disease impacts on dolphins.

lessons.name: Protection Measures
lessons.description: Marine protected areas, policy, and community-based conservation.

lessons.name: Monitoring and Research Methods
lessons.description: Survey methods, tagging, and data analysis used in dolphin research.

name: Biology of Pufferfishes
description: This course delves into the unique biological characteristics of pufferfishes, including their defense mechanisms and ecological roles.
author: 654f9ec2ea7ead465908d1e3

modules.name: Pufferfish Physiology
modules.description: Physiological adaptations of pufferfishes, including toxin production and buoyancy.

lessons.name: Tetrodotoxin Biology
lessons.description: Origins, effects, and ecological role of tetrodotoxin in pufferfishes.

lessons.name: Buoyancy and Swim Bladders
lessons.description: How pufferfish control buoyancy and their unique morphological traits.

name: Anatomy of Seals
description: This course examines the anatomical features of seals, focusing on their adaptations to marine environments.
author: 654f9ec2ea7ead465908d1e3

modules.name: Seal Anatomy
modules.description: Anatomical adaptations of seals for aquatic life.

lessons.name: Flippers and Locomotion
lessons.description: How seals move in water and on land; skeletal adaptations.

lessons.name: Thermoregulation
lessons.description: Blubber, circulation, and behaviors that help seals maintain body temperature.

name: Evolution of Sharks
description: This course traces the evolutionary history of sharks, exploring their diversity and survival strategies over millions of years.
author: 654f9ec2ea7ead465908d1e3

modules.name: Shark Evolutionary History
modules.description: Key events in shark evolution and major clades.

lessons.name: Ancient Lineages
lessons.description: Fossil record and ancient shark forms.

lessons.name: Modern Diversification
lessons.description: How modern sharks diversified into present-day families.

name: Ecology of Starfishes
description: This course investigates the ecological roles of starfishes in marine ecosystems, including their interactions with other species.
author: 654f9ec2ea7ead465908d1e3

modules.name: Starfish Ecology
modules.description: Ecological roles of starfishes and their interactions in benthic communities.

lessons.name: Feeding and Predation
lessons.description: Starfish feeding strategies and impact on prey populations.

lessons.name: Regeneration and Life History
lessons.description: Regenerative abilities and reproductive strategies of starfishes.

name: Diversity of Stingrays
description: This course explores the diversity of stingrays, their habitats, behaviors, and the challenges they face in the wild.
author: 654f9ec2ea7ead465908d1e3

modules.name: Stingray Diversity
modules.description: Diversity, morphology, and habitats of stingrays.

lessons.name: Morphological Diversity
lessons.description: Body shapes, sizes, and specializations among stingrays.

lessons.name: Habitat Use
lessons.description: Benthic vs pelagic habitats and movement patterns.

name: Diet of Sea Turtles
description: This course examines the dietary habits of sea turtles, their foraging behaviors, and nutritional needs.
author: 654f9ec2ea7ead465908d1e3

modules.name: Sea Turtle Diets
modules.description: Foraging ecology and dietary variation in sea turtles.

lessons.name: Herbivorous vs Carnivorous Diets
lessons.description: Differences in diet among sea turtle species and their ecological implications.

lessons.name: Foraging Grounds
lessons.description: Key foraging habitats and migratory feeding behavior.
